summary: A delayed Flutter WebRTC method-channel response from clearing a source could overwrite the current video renderer state after a new stream was attached. Renderer method completions now check the source generation and are invalidated on dispose.

checks.name: Regression before fix
checks.observation: After the new stream reported dimensions and attached successfully, completing the older null-source request reset the video size/render state.

checks.name: Full flutter_webrtc package tests
checks.observation: All 22 package tests passed, including delayed clear after new source attach.

remaining: The source race is a concrete renderer defect but is not proven to be the cause of the reported black screen. Verify an active browser publication on the Mac, decoded/displayed frames after source switching, and normal unpublish. Keep FE-61 open pending paired runtime acceptance.
